arxiv-2106-13082.title: On the relationship between predictive coding and backpropagation
arxiv-2106-13082.creator: Robert Rosenbaum
arxiv-2106-13082.description: Abstract NOTE: The original published version of this manuscript in PLoS One contains several uncorrected errors in mathematical formulae. These errors all involve instances in which the prediction errors, \epsilon , are replaced by the negative prediction errors, -\epsilon . A correction to these errors was submitted to PLoS One, but it remains unpublished as of April 16, 2024.

arxiv-2310-19623.title: The Geometry of Drinfeld Modular Forms
arxiv-2310-19623.creator: Jesse Franklin
arxiv-2310-19623.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jesse Franklin. We give a geometric perspective on the algebra of Drinfeld modular forms for congruence subgroups Γ ≤ GL 2 ​ ( 𝔽 q ​ [ T ] ) . \Gamma\leq\mathrm{GL}_{2}(\mathbb{F}_{q}[T]). In particular, we describe an isomorphism between the section ring of a line bundle on the stacky modular curve for Γ 2 \Gamma_{2} and the algebra of Drinfeld modular forms for Γ 2 , \Gamma_{2}, where Γ 2 \Gamma_{2} is the subgroup of square-determinant matrices in Γ .

arxiv-2311-17552.title: An Efficient Illumination Invariant Tiger Detection Framework for Wildlife Surveillance
arxiv-2311-17552.creator: Gaurav Pendharkar, A.Ancy Micheal, Jason Misquitta, Ranjeesh Kaippada
arxiv-2311-17552.description: Abstract Tiger conservation necessitates the strategic deployment of multifaceted initiatives encompassing the preservation of ecological habitats, anti-poaching measures, and community involvement for sustainable growth in the tiger population. With the advent of artificial intelligence, tiger surveillance can be automated using object detection. In this paper, an accurate illumination invariant framework is proposed based on EnlightenGAN and YOLOv8 for tiger detection.

arxiv-2401-04673.title: Proceedings of the OCNMP-2024 Conference:
arxiv-2401-04673.creator: Bad Ems, 23-29 June 2024
arxiv-2401-04673.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Bad Ems, 23-29 June 2024. In this paper we systematically consider various ways of generating integrable and separable Hamiltonian systems in canonical and in non-canonical representations from algebraic curves on the plane. In particular, we consider Stäckel transform between two pairs of Stäckel systems, generated by 2 ​ n 2n -parameter algebraic curves on the plane, as well as Miura maps between Stäckel systems generated by ( n + N ) (n+N) -parameter algebraic curves, leading to multi-Hamiltonian representation of these systems.

arxiv-2405-11525.title: Overcoming Data and Model heterogeneities in Decentralized Federated Learning via Synthetic Anchors
arxiv-2405-11525.creator: Chun-Yin Huang, Kartik Srinivas, Xin Zhang, Xiaoxiao Li
arxiv-2405-11525.description: Abstract Conventional Federated Learning (FL) involves collaborative training of a global model while maintaining user data privacy. One of its branches, decentralized FL, is a serverless network that allows clients to own and optimize different local models separately, which results in saving management and communication resources.

arxiv-2409-07618.title: Understanding Foundation Models: Are We Back in 1924? Thanks: This research was conducted with financial support of Science Foundation Ireland 12/RC/2289_P2 at Insight the SFI Research Centre for Data Analytics at Dublin City University.
arxiv-2409-07618.creator: Alan F. Smeaton
arxiv-2409-07618.description: Abstract This position paper explores the rapid development of Foundation Models (FMs) in AI and their implications for intelligence and reasoning. It examines the characteristics of FMs, including their training on vast datasets and use of embedding spaces to capture semantic relationships.

arxiv-2412-18104.title: Interference-free Operating System: A 6 Years’ Experience in Mitigating Cross-Core Interference in Linux
arxiv-2412-18104.creator: Zhaomeng Deng, Ziqi Zhang, Ding Li 1, Yao Guo 1, Yunfeng Ye, Yuxin Ren, Ning Jia, Xinwei Hu
arxiv-2412-18104.description: Abstract Real-time operating systems employ spatial and temporal isolation to guarantee predictability and schedulability of real-time systems on multi-core processors. Any unbounded and uncontrolled cross-core performance interference poses a significant threat to system time safety. However, the current Linux kernel has a number of interference issues and represents a primary source of interference.

arxiv-2508-17141.title: Orthogonal designs and symmetric Hadamard matrices
arxiv-2508-17141.creator: Dragomir Ž. ¯ Doković
arxiv-2508-17141.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Dragomir Ž. ¯ Doković. For a prime power q ≡ 3 ( mod 8 ) q\equiv 3\pmod{8} we construct skew-type and symmetric orthogonal designs with parameters ( 1 + q : 1 , q ) (1+q:~1,q) . Our main result is the construction of symmetric Hadamard matrices of order q ⁡ ( 1 + q ) q(1+q) for the same values of q q . In memory of Nikolay Alekseevich Balonin, my friend and collaborator.

arxiv-2511-17349.title: Euclidean coordinate-space perturbation theory with a single mass scale Preprint: CERN-TH-2025-239, MITP-25-074
arxiv-2511-17349.creator: Christoph L. Schröder, Harvey B. Meyer
arxiv-2511-17349.description: Abstract We develop elements of coordinate-space perturbation theory for massive quantum field theories in general d d -dimensional Euclidean space. Using the expansion in Gegenbauer polynomials, we provide analytic expressions for several three-point correlation functions in theories with one massive and one massless field.

arxiv-2511-18263.title: Approximating Maximum Properly Colored Forests via Degree Bounded Independent Sets
arxiv-2511-18263.creator: Yuhang Bai, Kristóf Bérczi, Johanna K. Siemelink
arxiv-2511-18263.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yuhang Bai, Kristóf Bérczi, Johanna K. Siemelink. In the Maximum-size Properly Colored Forest problem, we are given an edge-colored undirected graph and the goal is to find a properly colored forest with as many edges as possible.

arxiv-2601-17730.title: Production of high-spin ω J / ρ J \omega_{J}/\rho_{J} ( J = 3 , 4 , 5 J=3,4,5 ) mesons in π − ​ p \pi^{-}p reactions
arxiv-2601-17730.creator: Ting-Yan Li 1,2,3, Zi-Yue Bai 1,2,3, Xiang Liu 1,2,3,4
arxiv-2601-17730.description: Abstract In this work, we perform a comprehensive investigation of the production of high‑spin ω J \omega_{J} and ρ J \rho_{J} mesons ( J = 3 , 4 , 5 J=3,4,5 ) in π − ​ p \pi^{-}p reactions using an effective Lagrangian approach.

britannica-1911-turpentine.title: Turpentine (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-turpentine.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-turpentine.description: Article 'Turpentine' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 27), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. turbentine or terebentine from Lat. resina, resin of the terebinth, Gr. τερέβινθος or τέρμινθος), the oleo-resins which exude from certain trees, especially from some conifers— such as Pinus sylvestris—and from the terebinth tree, Pistacia terebinthus, L. It was to the product of the latter, now known as Chian turpentine, that the term was first applied. The terebinth tree and its resin were well known and highly prized from the earliest times.

pmc-11458489.title: Reply to: SARS-CoV-2 Transmission Rate Depends on Infectivity of the Virus Strain, Closeness of Contact, and the Immune Competence of the Infected Person
pmc-11458489.creator: Jiwoo Sim, Euncheol Son, Young June Choe
pmc-11458489.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). alternative infection routes for secondary cases, we acknowledge this limitation. While our study design focused on close contacts of confirmed cases, we cannot definitively exclude other sources of infection, as demonstrated in other outbreak investigations [3,4]. From original strain dominant periods to Delta dominant periods when 1,227 people among 1,286 people investigated were included, testing all relevant people was conducted, and classification and isolation of contacts were implemented within 24 hours following the diagnosis of the index case.

pmc-11473374.title: Challenging boundaries: is cross-protection evaluation necessary for African swine fever vaccine development? A case of oral vaccination in wild boar
pmc-11473374.creator: Estefanía Cadenas-Fernández, Sandra Barroso-Arévalo, Aleksandra Kosowska, Marta Díaz-Frutos, Carmina Gallardo, Antonio Rodríguez-Bertos, Jaime Bosch, Jose M. Sánchez-Vizcaíno, Jose A. Barasona
pmc-11473374.description: African swine fever (ASF) poses a significant threat to domestic pigs and wild boar (Sus scrofa) populations, with the current epidemiological situation more critical than ever. The disease has spread across five continents, causing devastating losses in the swine industry. Although extensive research efforts are ongoing to develop an effective and safe vaccine, this goal remains difficult to achieve.

pmc-11590190.title: Association between serum neurofilament light chain levels and chronic kidney disease: a cross-sectional population-based study from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (2013–2014 cycle)
pmc-11590190.creator: Jian-De Lu, Kaisaierjiang Kadier, Diliyaer Dilixiati, Bingzhang Qiao, Renaguli Nuer, Abudureheman Zebibula, Mulati Rexiati, Kai Li, ShuiXue Li
pmc-11590190.description: BackgroundThe relationships of serum neurofilament light chain (NfL) levels with chronic kidney disease (CKD) and renal function indicators remain controversial, and comprehensive studies with large sample sizes are lacking.MethodsIn total, 2,051 participants aged 20 to 75 years were identified from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (2013-2014 cycle).

pmc-11605593.title: 10183- MET-14 SALVAGE SURGERY FOR LOCAL PROGRESSION AFTER RADIATION THERAPY OF BRAIN METASTASES
pmc-11605593.creator: Hideyuki Arita, Toru Umehara, Koji Takano, Yoshiko Okita, Manabu Kinoshita
pmc-11605593.description: Recent advancement in cancer treatments have prolonged survival after the onset of brain metastases (BM), and this trend increases the risk of local progression (LP) after radiotherapy (RT)of BM. Salvage options include surgical resection, re-irradiation and medical therapies, but there is no standard management for this clinical setting. This study aimed to evaluate the outcome of salvage surgery.

pmc-11609584.title: Heat application in live cell imaging
pmc-11609584.creator: Linda Sistemich, Simon Ebbinghaus
pmc-11609584.description: Thermal heating of biological samples allows to reversibly manipulate cellular processes with high temporal and spatial resolution. Manifold heating techniques in combination with live‐cell imaging were developed, commonly tailored to customized applications. They include Peltier elements and microfluidics for homogenous sample heating as well as infrared lasers and radiation absorption by nanostructures for spot heating.

pmc-12438057.title: How to do research and be a researcher
pmc-12438057.creator: R. Stewart
pmc-12438057.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). There’s a lot of advice and written material available on research methods but much less on ‘how to be a researcher’. However, understanding this is as much a part of carrying out research as understanding a particular methodology. Having delivered countless teaching sessions on research design, I thought it would be interesting to consider (and attempt to write about) the origins of research principles, how these have developed over time, and what’s common across different fields.

pmc-12656217.title: Effects of Combined Repeated Sprint and Large-Sided Game Training on Physical Performance in Elite U20 Soccer Players: A Randomised Controlled Trial
pmc-12656217.creator: Mehdi Ben Brahim, Bekir Erhan Orhan, Hussain Yasin, Shaher A. I. Shalfawi
pmc-12656217.description: Background: The purpose of the present study was to investigate the impact of a combined Repeated Sprint Training (RST) with Large-Sided Soccer Games (LSSG) on soccer players’ physical performance indicators. Methods: A randomised controlled trial protocol was designed and implemented to examine the effects of an 8-week training programme on the physical performance of U20 national team soccer players.

pmc-12663860.title: Rare Case of Co‐Existing Hydatid Cyst Along With Pulmonary Tuberculosis; Both Being Evident on Chest X‐Ray
pmc-12663860.creator: Thasniya Ummer, Salman Qayum, Harshana Bandara
pmc-12663860.description: A 45‐year‐old male immigrant builder presented with haemoptysis and a dry cough. Imaging revealed a right apical cavitating lesion and an incidental calcified hepatic cyst. Sputum confirmed Mycobacterium tuberculosis , while CT identified a ce5‐stage hydatid cyst. He received anti‐TB therapy, highlighting concurrent infections and the value of comprehensive radiologic evaluation.

pmc-12698758.title: Machine learning constructs a ferroptosis related signature for predicting prognosis and drug sensitivity in lung cancer
pmc-12698758.creator: Zihao Li, Yibing Chen, Benxin Hou, Yanjun Mi, Chunlin Fu, Zhaoyang Han, Qing Tang, Weihong Sun, Qing Xia, Yuan Liao, Zhengzhi Zou
pmc-12698758.description: PurposeFerroptosis is a novel form of iron-dependent programmed cell death that is associated with the progression of various tumors and cancer treatment responses. However, its role in the clinical treatment of lung cancer, particularly in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) and lung squamous cell carcinoma (LUSC), remains poorly understood.

pmc-13081346.title: Benefits of physical exercises in chronic kidney disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
pmc-13081346.creator: Yanqin Chen, Song Ren, Xiaoxiu Yao, Mengjiao Li, Guisen Li, Yunlin Feng, Xiaoling Shi
pmc-13081346.description: Physical exercise has been proven to be beneficial for chronic kidney disease (CKD) patients; however, there is a lack of a comprehensive summary of existing literature, especially the results from randomized controlled trials (RCTs). We had conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis to evaluate the benefits of physical exercise in chronic kidney disease.

pmc-13148207.title: Synthesis and structure of (Z)-8-methyl-2-(8-methyl-2,3,4,9-tetra­hydro­carbazol-1-yl­idene)-2,3,4,9-tetra­hydro­carbazol-1-one
pmc-13148207.creator: Makuteswaran Sridharan, Aravazhi Amalan Thiruvalluvar
pmc-13148207.description: In the title compound, the dihedral angle between the indole fused ring units is 36.37 (5)° and an intra­molecular N—H⋯O hydrogen bond closes an S(7) ring. In the extended structure, inversion dimers linked by pairwise N—H⋯O hydrogen bonds generate an R22(10) loop. Secondary C—H⋯π contacts consolidate the packing and a π–π stacking inter­action is also observed.

pmc-13427409.title: Enhancement of solar photovoltaic potentials in central and eastern China due to “Clean Air Actions”
pmc-13427409.creator: Zhigao Zhou, Yang Zhong, Zhijiang Zhang, Lijie He, Wenmin Qin, Lunche Wang
pmc-13427409.description: SummaryThe Chinese central and eastern (CCE) regions are both densely populated and heavily polluted, as well as deeply energy-demanding areas. Meanwhile, improvement of air quality occurred in these regions due to “Clean Air Actions” since 2013, probably resulting in increase in surface solar radiation (SSR).

pmc-13475891.title: Identification of pear tissue mechanical parameters by integrating machine learning and optimization methods
pmc-13475891.creator: Yuanyuan Dai, Fei Meng, Xiaohua Xie, Yangyang Liu
pmc-13475891.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The mechanical properties of fruit tissue play a crucial role in various food processing activities, including sorting, packaging, and transportation. Most traditional testing processes are destructive, time-consuming, and cannot capture the mechanical response under loading conditions. The present research proposes a parameter identification model that combines experimental analysis, finite element analysis, and a hybrid machine learning model to describe the viscoelastic behaviour of pear tissue.

pmc-13581965.title: Editorial: Oral health and successful aging: integrating basic research, clinical insights and community health

pmc-13700119.title: Nonuniform settlement of C2 lateral mass: a pathological anatomic change related to the lateral atlantoaxial osteoarthritis
pmc-13700119.creator: Chao Tang, Ying Zhang, Xian Ming Huang, Xu Zhao, Tong Wei Chu
pmc-13700119.description: ObjectiveNonuniform settlement of C2 lateral mass (C2LM-NUS) was defined as an asymmetrical change of the bilateral C2 lateral masses. This study aimed to determine the association between the nonuniform settlement of C2 lateral mass (C2LM-NUS) and lateral atlantoaxial osteoarthritis (AAOA).MethodsA total of 573 patients who underwent a head and neck or cervical spine CT scan were reviewed.

uslaw-usc-t10-s1172.title: 10 U.S.C. § 1172 — Enlisted members: during war or emergency; discharge
uslaw-usc-t10-s1172.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s1172.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part II (Personnel); Chapter 59 (Separation). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. A person enlisted under section 518 of this title may be discharged at any time by the President, or otherwise according to law.

uslaw-usc-t22-s275.title: 22 U.S.C. § 275 — International Hydrographic Bureau
uslaw-usc-t22-s275.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t22-s275.description: United States Code, Title 22 (Foreign Relations And Intercourse); Chapter 7 (International Bureaus, Congresses, Etc.). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. To enable the United States to become a member of the International Hydrographic Bureau, and for the first annual contribution of the United States toward the creation and maintenance of such bureau, there is hereby appropriated out of money in the Treasury.
